events.title: Demo Update 1.0.5 - Tutorial Fixes

events.title: Demo out now!
events.summary: Hello everyone, The demo for Line Clear is now live!Demo FeaturesIn the demo, you control a rural junction managing two platforms and outbound routing to two further destinations. The demo's aimed to give you a glimpse on the core mechanics of the game.The game is still a work in progress and will change over time.Have any ideas? events.title: Demo Announcement
events.summary: Hello everyone, We’re happy to announce that Line Clear will be taking part in the upcoming Steam Next Fest (October 20th - October 27th). During the next fest, our demo will be live. You can get hands on with the levers yourself, and most importantly, give us feedback to take the game in a direction that suits you.
